02-digest — the app is a module dir, like every rut program: the
manifest carries the deps, and the embedder (`src/main.rs`,
`tests/session.rs`) loads this dir through the manifest lane
(`load_dir_session_with`) — same host half, new mount lane.

THE CDN ROWS: pouch, json and nmapset ship as COMMITTED v7 compiled
bundles (dist/std/<pkg>.rutbundle, jsDelivr-served at the tag,
sha256-pinned here — the pin is law at the mount door on every load).
All three are GENERIC owners, and since the generic-source riding law
their bundles carry the source beside the binaries: this consumer
spells `Vec<opaque>` and drives json's traits + writer directly, and
the shapes compile from the bundles at the link. The embedder names
its remote policy (Loader + HttpRemote::project_local) — a cold start
networks on its misses, a warm start is pure cache; the TESTS prime
an offline remote from the committed artifacts (dist/std plays the
wire), so the gates never touch the network. `nmapset` rides because a
bundle-mounted json's pack-time ledger names its dev closure — the
compiled rows reference the peer scopes, so the closure must contain
them (the six-pin law); json's optional integration groups mount only
for closure members, so the nmapset rows stay inert unless spelled.
json's own `[deps]` pulls strbuild (the writer's accumulator), so the
embedder pairs the load with `strbuild::pkg()` — and nmapset's bundle
carries `nmap_host`, whose bodies bind beside it (the tests do;
exactly ink + `logger::pkg`).
